name: Mesquite mistletoe
desc: Mesquite mistletoe (Phoradendron californicum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 84 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Phoradendron californicum, the desert mistletoe or mesquite mistletoe, is a hemiparasitic plant native to southern California, Nevada, Arizona, Sonora, Sinaloa and Baja California.
